text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: M-My weight has increased... it has!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well... if you eat red bean buns and milk 
every single day like that, wouldn't that 
just naturally happen?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
B-But stakeouts call for anpan and milk! 
That's just the golden rule...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But if you do that, won't both your 
hands be tied up in an emergency?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That is... indeed the case, yes...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this? As part of your diet, 
how about chewing gum instead of eating 
bean-paste buns for a while?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Chewing gum, is it... Understood. I will 
try going with that for a while.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hey, good work. How's the stakeout going?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to you! Since I can act 
immediately, my instruction rate has also 
improved drastically, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I've been running non-stop 
lately— Mmh, speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You there, halt! Bringing handheld gaming 
devices is strictly prohibiiiiited!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My weight... has returned to normal, sir! 
So this is the power of chewing gum...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Once in a while... chewing gum might not 
be a bad idea."

And so, thanks to the gum (?), Fenomeno 
successfully managed to lose weight.
